description: This file defines internal mechanisms for operator dispatching in the ATen library of PyTorch, including RAII guards for controlling autograd and variable type dispatching, with emphasis on legacy dispatch methods and internal kernel implementation guards.

classes.name: AutoDispatchBelowAutograd
classes.description: RAII guard to disable autograd dispatch keys, used internally for kernel implementations.

classes.name: AutoNonVariableTypeMode
classes.description: RAII guard to disable variable type dispatch, deprecated for release 1.10.

classes.name: AutoDispatchSkipFunctionalize
classes.description: RAII guard to skip functionalization dispatch key.

classes.name: AutoDispatchBelowADInplaceOrView
classes.description: RAII guard to disable autograd and ADInplaceOrView dispatch keys for kernel invariants.

methods.name: AutoDispatchBelowAutograd
methods.description: Constructor initializes guard to disable autograd dispatch keys.

methods.name: AutoNonVariableTypeMode
methods.description: Constructor initializes guard to disable variable type dispatch, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: AutoDispatchSkipFunctionalize
methods.description: Constructor initializes guard to skip functionalize dispatch key.

methods.name: AutoDispatchBelowADInplaceOrView
methods.description: Constructor initializes guard to disable autograd and ADInplaceOrView dispatch keys.
